purpose: separate the pure MASS (dose) effect from the w-RANKING effect on the blind off-catalogue SGMC control

control_construction.rand10minus: 3,765 parent dots removed uniformly at random (default_rng(20261023))
control_construction.rand10plus: 3,765 candidates drawn uniformly at random from H19-5 & ~R0 & d_cat>3px
control_construction.rand10swap: both of the above at fixed count 37,654
control_construction.note: diagnostics only: no GeoTIFF, no ledger row, no (axis, value) pair, never a candidate

r10minus.reading: the w-ranking moves the blind control DOWN by -0.001831 relative to random donors

r10plus.reading: the w-ranking moves the blind control UP by +0.001756 relative to random donors

r10swap.reading: the w-ranking moves the blind control UP by +0.000462 relative to random donors

r10minus.rule: closest-to-zero when signs agree, midpoint when they disagree; band +/-0.005, widened to cover both instruments

r10plus.rule: closest-to-zero when signs agree, midpoint when they disagree; band +/-0.005, widened to cover both instruments

r10swap.rule: closest-to-zero when signs agree, midpoint when they disagree; band +/-0.005, widened to cover both instruments
